title: uidropdownmenu
summary: UIDropDownMenu.xml is Benilla's shared dropdown kit (capsule template, row template, 2-level list, MENU displayMode, hover auto-close) - framework plumbing, not a surface. MSUI has no transcription of the kit and none of its consumers currently use a vanilla-styled dropdown (settings use ImGui combos; the world map / trainer / tradeskill filter dropdowns that would consume it are themselves absent - tracked as gaps on those entries). Realized, where needed, through MSUI's own ImGui widgets.
